title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Ava Thompson
description: Motivation: provide first-party RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and a set of quickstarts to help engineers onboard with agent patterns (retrieval + tools) quickly. This PR adds opinionated starter templates for a RAG agent, short walkthrough quickstarts (Python + TS), examples for tool-calling (search, calendar, HTTP tool), and updates to the docs site to surface the new content. Changes were driven by ENG-1732 and requests from several early customers wanting canonical examples that combine KV-prompting, cache usage, and tool fallbacks. Summary of changes: added templates under redwood-examples/agents/rag-templates, added two quickstarts (python and typescript) under redwood-quickstarts/agents, added docs pages and sidebar entries in redwood-docs/site (including links from the getting-started and integrations sections), and added CI checks for docs build and example tests. Checklist: - [x] RAG templates added and tested locally - [x] Quickstarts (py/ts) with README and minimal runnable examples - [x] Tool-calling examples with mocked tool harnesses and integration tests - [x] Docs site pages and sidebar updates - [x] CI e2e examples run in lightweight mode - [x] Reviewed by Docs and SDK owners Related: Linear ENG-1732, DOC-58. This description contains the context, testing notes, and rollout plan. Testing: unit tests for quickstart helpers added, integration smoke tests run in CI using lightweight docker images. Rollout: documentation staged behind a feature flag until next docs release window (2026-02-20); examples published to redwood-examples registry and tagged v0.3.0. Breaking changes: none. Merge plan: squash-merge after approvals and green CI.
